description: BD TOPO is the national 3D topographic vector database of France produced by IGN. Version 3.5 describes the territory and its infrastructure at metric precision in themes covering administrative units, buildings, hydrography, named places, land cover, services and activities, transport and regulated zones. The 3D production process gives the altitude of objects and the height of buildings, relief is described by digital terrain models, and since version 3.0 every object has a unique identifier that is stable over time. Besides the quarterly editions IGN publishes BD TOPO Express, a weekly edition available since May 2025, and a Différentiel product listing geometric and semantic changes between two quarterly editions. Coverage: France. Access: downloads of the latest edition by département in Shapefile and by region or all France in SQL and GeoPackage, plus quality control files, documentation, WMTS change layers and vector tiles, listed on data.gouv.fr and cartes.gouv.fr. Licence: Licence Ouverte 2.0; free. Caveats: building heights come from photogrammetric production and roof shape is not modelled, so detailed 3D geometry needs other sources. Simulation uses are national building inventory and heights for exposure, energy and urban climate models, and networks from the transport theme. Related records: the BDNB national building database, which builds on public building data, and EUBUCCO.
